t: 在阿利得斯和阿巴西德斯在库法附近的巴克哈姆拉战役后,阿利得叛乱以伊萨·伊本·穆萨之弟易卜拉欣之…
te: Following the Battle of Bakhamra between Alids and Abbasids near Kufa, the Alid rebellion ends with the death of Ibrahi…
dz: 在阿利得斯和阿巴西德斯在库法附近的巴克哈姆拉战役后,阿利得叛乱以伊萨·伊本·穆萨之弟易卜拉欣之死而告终.
de: Following the Battle of Bakhamra between Alids and Abbasids near Kufa, the Alid rebellion ends with the death of Ibrahim, brother of Isa ibn Musa.

t: Ibrahim ibn Abdallah的死标志着762-763年阿里德起义的结束.
te: The death of Ibrahim ibn Abdallah marks the end of the Alid revolt of 762–763.
dz: Ibrahim ibn Abdallah的死标志着762-763年阿里德起义的结束.
de: The death of Ibrahim ibn Abdallah marks the end of the Alid revolt of 762–763.

t: 皇帝君士坦丁五世的拜占庭军队在安契亚卢斯战役中击败了保加利亚军队.
te: The Byzantine army of emperor Constantine V defeats the Bulgarian forces in the Battle of Anchialus.
dz: 皇帝君士坦丁五世的拜占庭军队在安契亚卢斯战役中击败了保加利亚军队.
